contracts: duplicate-rejecting safe YAML and bounded include expansion
contained no-follow scenario assets and exclusive artifact writes
allocation-free generation and email-expansion preflight budgets
one public uint64 generation seed propagated through worker contexts
linear bounded parser records and a measured evaluator capacity envelope
no-symlink Splunk staging and stream-counted archive extraction

yaml_contract.production_boundaries: all scenario, include, overlay, persona, activity-pool, configuration-validation, and email-corpus YAML reads use DuplicateKeySafeLoader
yaml_contract.repair: reconciled each shadowed site definition into one mapping while retaining the previously effective routes and restoring the unreachable route definitions
yaml_contract.fixture_result: all 9 shipped scenario fixtures pass schema and semantic validation after built-in persona composition

generation_capacity_contract.override: allow_large_workload is explicit in validator, generator, and CLI boundaries and is recorded in collection metadata
generation_capacity_contract.safety_note: the resource override never bypasses path, file-type, or YAML ambiguity checks

generation_seed_contract.metadata: effective generation_seed is recorded in collection_profile.json
generation_seed_contract.verification: default repeat and identical explicit seeds are byte-identical; distinct explicit seeds change rendered output

evaluation_capacity_contract.override: allow_large_evaluation is an explicit evaluator and CLI decision

splunk_contract.result: supported logs, app directories, ZIP files, and TAR files reject symlinks and special members; archives are preflighted and stream-counted with partial-tree cleanup
splunk_contract.external_runtime: licensed Splunk/Docker integration remained unavailable; static, unit filesystem, archive, and loopback harness controls passed

quality_gates.name: malicious_and_control_regressions
quality_gates.result: paired rejection/control tests cover duplicate YAML, include nodes, corpus paths, artifact paths and overwrite, workload and attachment budgets, huge CIDRs, record/corpus limits, and Splunk symlink/archive inputs

quality_gates.name: fixture_validation
quality_gates.result: 9 of 9 shipped scenario fixtures have zero semantic errors

quality_gates.name: non_slow_tests
quality_gates.result: 5227 passed, 41 skipped in 251.50 seconds on the unrestricted final run

quality_gates.name: ruff_and_format
quality_gates.result: All checks passed; 460 files already formatted

quality_gates.name: json_and_diff_integrity
quality_gates.result: finding and empirical JSON ledgers parse; git diff --check reports no whitespace errors

limitations: The licensed Splunk external parser runtime was unavailable, so runtime ingestion is not claimed.
The evaluator measurement isolates retained eCAR parse objects; scorer working sets require additional headroom and the default 500,000-record cap is intentionally conservative.
Reconciled duplicate site-map routes can change default generated browsing output because formerly unreachable authored routes now participate in selection.
Generated datasets and temporary capacity corpora remain untracked.
